introHtml: Adjustable lanyards and badges let your team or event attendees customize the fit for comfort and convenience. Whether you need breakaway safety lanyards for a manufacturing site or retractable badge reels for a conference, adjustable options like the A-Just-A-Lanyard or the Silkscreened Wrist Lanyard ensure a secure hold. Imprint your logo with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation for a polished look that keeps your brand visible all day.
